name: fig_compat_region_3d
title: Three-dimensional compatibility region over temperature, magnetic field and heat load
question: What region of (temperature, field, heat load) can a real configuration certify, and where does missing documentation turn the answer into Need more information rather than a pass or a fail?
model: Mandatory requirements temperature.range point_within T and magnetic_field.max at_least B, plus the joule_heating_vs_cooling_power coupled model (I^2 R = Q <= P_cool(T_doc), T_doc <= T_op = T).
data: 3920 Lean checks (check_batch, 14.5 s): 14 T x 9 or 11 B x 14 Q for lakeshore_crx_vf and qd_dynacool_9T_eto_res; envelopes from data/cryostats/lakeshore_crx.json and qd_ppms_dynacool.json. paper/data/fig_compat_region_3d.json.
caption: Markers are Lean checker verdicts on a (T, B, Q) grid for a synthetic experiment requiring temperature T, field B and the Joule-heating model with heat load Q; non-passing points are drawn faint. The box is the sourced envelope (temperature range, maximum field and, where documented, cooling power), drawn as an overlay. For the CRX-VF (a) the certified volume is bounded by 10-420 K, 2.5 T and the 1 W cooling power at 4.2 K; for the DynaCool (b), whose cooling power is not documented, every point inside the envelope is Need more information.
